findings.evidence: Lines 12-17 document `[Semiring C] [Bialgebra R C]` invariants as representations of `Spec C` as an affine group scheme; the declaration at lines 61-71 assumes only `Bialgebra R C`.
findings.fix: Replace the group-scheme/fixed-vector wording with an affine monoid scheme statement, or explicitly qualify the group-scheme interpretation as the Hopf-algebra case.
findings.issue: The docs say a right comodule over an arbitrary bialgebra `C` is a representation of the affine group scheme `Spec C`, but a bialgebra only gives an affine monoid scheme; the group-scheme interpretation needs Hopf/algebra antipode hypotheses not present in the file.

findings.evidence: Line 19 uses `ρ - (· ⊗ 1)`, while lines 61-65 assume only `CommSemiring R` and `AddCommMonoid M`; the definition at lines 71-72 uses an equality predicate, not a subtraction map.
findings.fix: Describe `invariants` as the submodule/equalizer of the two linear maps `ρ` and `m ↦ m ⊗ 1`, not as a kernel of a difference.
findings.issue: The module doc says the invariants are cut out as the kernel of `ρ - (· ⊗ 1)`, but the file works over `CommSemiring R` and `AddCommMonoid M`, where subtraction and kernels of differences are not available.

summary: The new declarations are documented, but the module/definition docs overclaim the geometric interpretation and use additive-group language unavailable at the stated semiring generality.
